title: Intermediate data-science assignment series
summary: Students complete three intermediate data-science assignments using supplied datasets and progressive multi-step questions, but with less programmatic and column detail than the introductory series. Researchers benchmarked both raw and engineered prompts to identify the contextual knowledge students must obtain from course materials.

sources.title: Implications of ChatGPT for Data Science Education

assessment.summary: Complete progressive dataset-analysis questions while deriving missing implementation details from lectures, labs, and dataset exploration.
student_actions: Implement statistical and machine-learning analyses using course knowledge.

student_role.description: Researchers benchmarked ChatGPT-3.5 with raw and engineered prompts; student AI permission is not reported.
